sections.text:
This document outlines the minor 
maintenance procedure P1, to be performed every three years Y3 or after 1000 
cycles.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Mohamed Abd Ell Hady Eskander, tested by eng. Mohamed Abd El Dayem, approved 
 by eng. Hamdy Radwan Aly general director, accepted by eng. Motawee Hassan Aly 
 Head Sector of El Shawashna SS, certified by eng. Ahmed Said Abd El Aziz 
 quality control general director, MPIS Coordinator.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc

The circuit breaker must be isolated and properly earthed at both sides, it 
 should be in ON position.
Disconnect DC Voltage
Ensure that the CB isolated completely and grounded on both sides
Control power disconnected
Isolate the DC voltage
Change remote switch to local operation position
Proper well fixed ladder should be used for climbing on the breaker
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump .
Safety equipment "belt, shoes, .... etc"
Complete toolset, scratch, electrical grease, rag, and air blower
Gas detector, new bottle sf6 gas and filling tool.

Check that 
 nuts and bolts are properly tightened

Check SF6 
 pressure on density switch (add SF6 if it is necessary) reference value 7 bar 
 at 20C

Monitor the 
 density switch pressure thresholds; replace the density switches if it is out 
 of tolerance
 As a precaution, before replacing the density switches, we recommend 
 you to repeat the check in a room with a temperature stabilized at around 20 
 C

Check that 
 the circuit breaker is operated several times per year, if this is not the 
 case, initiate a closing and opening cycle in local and remote mode and, if 
 the option has been fitted, under voltage tripping

Check the 
 density switch pressure thresholds and test the operation of the density 
 switch micro-switches

Check the 
 operating mechanism charging time
 Initiate "0" and "1" operations using the control channels : 
 local and remote control and under voltage tripping

Introduction
This document outlines the minor 
maintenance procedure P1, to be performed every three years Y3 or after 1000 
cycles.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Mohamed Abd Ell Hady Eskander, tested by eng. Mohamed Abd El Dayem, approved 
 by eng. Hamdy Radwan Aly general director, accepted by eng. Motawee Hassan Aly 
 Head Sector of El Shawashna SS, certified by eng. Ahmed Said Abd El Aziz 
 quality control general director, MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
The circuit breaker must be isolated and properly earthed at both sides, it 
 should be in ON position.

Ensure that the CB isolated completely and grounded on both sides
Control power disconnected
Isolate the DC voltage
Change remote switch to local operation position
Proper well fixed ladder should be used for climbing on the breaker
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump .
Tools and Equipment
Safety equipment "belt, shoes, .... etc"
Complete toolset, scratch, electrical grease, rag, and air blower
Gas detector, new bottle sf6 gas and filling tool.
Work to be Carried Out
Check that 
 nuts and bolts are properly tightened
Check SF6

 at 20C
Monitor the 
 density switch pressure thresholds; replace the density switches if it is out 
 of tolerance
 As a precaution, before replacing the density switches, we recommend

 C
Check that

Check the

Check the

 local and remote control and under voltage tripping
